citation: UAE Cabinet Resolution No. (22) of 2016 on the unified definition of small and medium enterprises (uaelegislation.gov.ae/en/legislations/1059), under Federal Law No. (2) of 2014 on SMEs. Thresholds by sector on full-time employees and annual revenue; the SMEs Council reviews them at least every three years. Where the two criteria give different classes this platform takes the higher class (rule HIGHER_OF_BOTH) — confirm that reading with the institution's counsel and the revision in force before go-live.
